ASSET_THRESHOLD.description: Any item purchase above this threshold is classified as a Fixed Asset rather than an Expense.

GST_TRIGGER.description: Any purchase above this amount requires tax verification if tax components are missing.

INVENTORY_METHOD.description: Default cost flow assumption method for inventory tracking.

DEPRECIATION_METHOD.description: Default method for Fixed Asset depreciation (Written Down Value).

CREDIT_TERMS_DEFAULT.description: Default payment terms in days when credit is mentioned but days are unspecified.
